40100.meaning1: who has wisdom and virtue; who has understanding and integrity

examples.text: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.

40104.meaning1: extent of wisdom; sphere of understanding
40104.meaning2: extent of wisdom; sphere of understanding

examples.text: ettāvatā adhivacanapatho, ettāvatā niruttipatho, ettāvatā paññattipatho, ettāvatā paññ'āvacaraṃ, ettāvatā vaṭṭaṃ vattati itthattaṃ paññāpanāya yadidaṃ nāmarūpaṃ saha viññāṇena aññam'aññapaccayatā pavattati.

40105.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, vibhāvī, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: samāhitass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa. paññāvato ayaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo duppaññassa. nippapañcass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassā'ti

40106.meaning1: who professes a doctrine of understanding; who teaches wisdom
40106.meaning2: who profess a doctrine of understanding; who teaches wisdom

examples.text: santi, kassapa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā paññāvādā. te anekapariyāyena paññāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.

40107.meaning1: liberated by understanding; emancipated by insight; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.
paññāvimutto, idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.

40109.meaning1: liberation by understanding; emancipation by insight

examples.text: cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā, abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijar'ūpagā.

so sace ākaṅkhati, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan'ti, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane'ti.

40110.meaning1: with liberation by understanding as the fruit; with emancipation by insight as the result

examples.text: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?

40111.meaning1: with liberation by understanding as fruit and benefit; with emancipation by insight as result and advantage

examples.text: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?

40112.meaning1: liberated by wisdom; emancipated by understanding

examples.text: eso ce, bhante, maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya, atha kiñ'carahi idh'ekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttino'ti?
sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, paññāvisiṭṭhaṃ labhate anuttaraṃ, pappoti bodhiṃ varabhūrimedhaso'ti.

40114.meaning1: purification of understanding; clarity of wisdom

examples.text: kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, magg'āmaggañāṇadassana, visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

40115.meaning1: growth of wisdom; increase in understanding

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, vuddhi yadidaṃ bhogavuddhi. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, vuddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāvuddhi. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, paññāvuddhiyā vaddhissāmā'ti.

40116.meaning1: which increases understanding; which develops wisdom
40116.commentary: (MNa) anuppannāya lokiyalok'uttarapaññāya uppādāya, uppannāya ca vuddhiyā saṃvattatī'ti paññāvuddhiko.

examples.text: nekkhammavitakko, bhikkhave, anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
so ca kho n'ev'attabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattati, paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.

40117.meaningLit: discourse on the increase of wisdom

40118.meaningLit: discourse on the increase of wisdom

40119.meaning1: weapon of wisdom; sword of understanding

examples.text: kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā. yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.
tīṇ'āvudhāni, sut'āvudhaṃ, pavivek'āvudhaṃ, paññ'āvudhaṃ.

40120.meaning1: expansion of wisdom; maturity of understanding
40120.commentary: (ANa) paññāvepullāya saṃvattantī'ti. katamaṃ paññāvepullaṃ? sattannañ'ca sekkhānaṃ puthujjanakalyāṇakassa ca paññā vepullaṃ gacchati, arahato paññā vepullaṃ gatā, paññāvepullāya saṃvattantī'ti idaṃ paññāvepullaṃ.

examples.text: ekadhammo, bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato paññāvepullāya saṃvattati.

40122.commentary: (DNa) paññāveyyattiyan'ti uttarapaccuttaranayena ñāṇabyattabhāvaṃ. (MNa) tassa atthañ'ca kāraṇañ'ca dassanasamatthatā paññāveyyattiyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yāva'd'ev'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso daharo hoti yuvā susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā tāva'd'eva paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgato hoti.
taṃ kiṃ maññati, bhavaṃ vacchāyano, samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ? paṇḍito maññe'ti.

40123.meaning1: power of wisdom; faculty of understanding

examples.text: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati… paññindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

40124.meaning1: ending of wisdom; cessation of the faculty of understanding

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā…paññ'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā…

40125.meaning1: leading to the ending of wisdom; going to the cessation of the faculty of understanding

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā…paññ'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā

40126.meaning1: appearance of wisdom; arising of the faculty of understanding

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā…paññ'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, paññ'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā…

40127.meaning1: with wisdom as chief characteristic; having understanding as the highest

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃadhipateyyā'ti? sat'ādhipateyyā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃuttarā'ti? paññ'uttarā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsārā'ti? vimuttisārā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃogadhā'ti? amat'ogadhā, bhante'ti.
samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

40128.commentary: (ANa) paññ'ūpavicārā'ti paññavanto bhaveyyāmā'ti evaṃ paññ'atthāya pavatt'ūpavicārā. ayam'eva nesaṃ vicāro citte upavicarati.

examples.text: katame cattāro? cand'obhāso, sūriy'obhāso, agg'obhāso, paññ'obhāso, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro obhāsā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ catunnaṃ obhāsānaṃ yadidaṃ paññ'obhāso'ti.
yam'etaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, ajita taṃ vadāmi te, yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, viññāṇassa nirodhena, etth'etaṃ uparujjhati.
accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

40131.commentary: (DNa) na kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo'ti idaṃ bhagavā yasmā padesenesa pañho pucchitabbo, ayañ'ca kho bhikkhu anupādinnake'pi gahetvā nippadesato pucchati, tasmā paṭisedheti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho pana te, ambaṭṭha, sahadhammiko pañho āgacchati, akāmā byākātabbo. sace tvaṃ na byākarissasi, aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissasi, tuṇhī vā bhavissasi, pakkamissasi vā etth'eva te sattadhā muddhā phalissati.
aññātavāde na saṇṭhātī'ti aññātavāde jānitavāde na saṇṭhāti. kathaṃ? ekacco pañhaṃ pucchati, taṃ itaro, manāpo tayā pañho pucchito, kahaṃ te esa uggahito'ti vadati.

40132.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of pañhattha

40133.meaning1: spontaneous answer to a question; ingenious reply to an enquiry

examples.text: purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ

aññatra asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā, aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā apariyādinnā'y'ev'assa, sāriputta, tathāgatassa dhammadesanā, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa dhammapadabyañjanaṃ, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa pañhapaṭibhānaṃ.

nānappakāra-roga-dukkh'ābhipīḷitattā āturakāyehi mahājanehi mah'ānubhāvo bhisakko viya rogatikicchan'atthaṃ, nānāvidha-kilesa-byādhi-pīḷitattā āturacittehi devamanussehi kilesabyādhitikicchan'atthaṃ dhammassavana-pañhapucchan'ādi-kāraṇehi bhagavā upasaṅkamitabbo.

sahavasantassa pana tehi saddhiṃ madhuraṃ sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ paṭisanthārakathaṃ sāraṇīyakathaṃ dhammīkathaṃ sarabhaññaṃ sākacchaṃ pañhapucchanaṃ pañhavissajjananti evamādikaraṇe sammukhā mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ nāma hoti.
kālena dhammassavanan'ti yuttappayuttakāle dhammassavanaṃ. dhammasākacchā'ti pañha-pucchana-vissajjanavasena pavattā saṃsandanakathā.

40137.meaning1: (ways of) answering a question; analysing a question
40137.commentary: (DNa) ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho, ṭhapanīyo pañho'ti imāni cattāri pañhabyākaraṇāni nāma.

examples.text: cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, pañhabyākaraṇāni. katamāni cattāri? atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo

40139.meaning1: who judges the debate; who adjudicates the question
40139.commentary: (NIDD1) apāhataṃ pañhavimaṃsakāse'ti. ye te pañhavīmaṃsakā parisā pārisajjā pāsārikā, te apaharanti.

examples.text: yam'assa vādaṃ parihīnam'āhu, apāhataṃ pañhavimaṃsakāse, paridevati socati hīnavādo, upaccagā man'ti anutthunāti.

40140.meaning1: answering a question; replying to a query

40141.meaning1: answer to a question; response to an enquiry

examples.text: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhaveyyākaraṇena, yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami

40143.commentary: (VISMa) pucchan'aṭṭhena pañhā, kiriyā karaṇaṃ kammaṃ, pañhā'va kammaṃ pañhākammaṃ, pucchanapayogo.

40144.meaning1: intelligent answer; eloquent response; lucid reply

examples.text: purimen'eva ahaṃ opammena bhoto kassapassa attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni vicitrāni pañhāpaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo ev'āhaṃ bhavantaṃ kassapaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ.

40146.commentary: (DNt) ñātuṃ icchito attho pañho, tassa vissajjanāni pañhābyākaraṇāni

examples.text: cattāro pañhābyākaraṇā, ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho, ṭhapanīyo pañho.

40147.meaning1: brought in for questioning; questioned directly

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
devatā'pi me etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ ime āyasmanto lābhino'ti. tam'enaṃ bhagavatā pañh'ābhipuṭṭhena byākatan'ti.

40149.meaning1: due to the construction of the question; because of the formation of the enquiry

40150.meaning1: delivery of the question; way of posing the question

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti, yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, duppañño ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā paññavā.

40151.meaning1: answer to a question; response to an enquiry
40151.meaning2: answer to a question; response to a an enquiry

examples.text: tena ca nātikiyā paricārakā attamanā ahesuṃ pamuditā pītisomanassajātā bhagavato pañhāveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā.

40152.meaning1: emerging of a question; arising line of enquiry
40152.commentary: (ANt) pañh'ummaggo'ti pañhagavesanaṃ, ñātuṃ icchitassa atthassa vīmaṃsanan'ti attho.

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhinnapaṭan'dharo muni, kāsāvavattho amamo nirāso, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca tath'eva mohaṃ, hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ.
cīvaracetāpannaṃ nāma hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā muttā vā maṇi vā pavāḷo vā phaliko vā paṭako vā suttaṃ vā kappāso vā.

te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpessanti, dussavāṇijjaṃ vā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā karissanti, paṭaggāhikasālaṃ vā pasāressantī'ti!

40157.notes: The Sanskrit suggests a different derivation from pata 'flying' + ga

examples.text: tato kīṭe paṭaṅge ca, yāva kunthakipillike, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.

40158.meaning2: kind of worm in the body

40165.commentary: (SNa) paṭapilotikānan'ti jiṇṇapilotikānaṃ terasahattho'pi hi navasāṭako dasānaṃ chinnakālato paṭṭhāya pilotikā'ti vuccati. iti ma'hārahāni vatthāni chinditvā kataṃ saṅghāṭiṃ sandhāya paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭin'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ kāretvā ye loke arahanto te uddissa kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.

40167.meaning1: (of a shoe) having several linings; with multiple layers

examples.text: atha kho, assalāyana, asito devalo isi kesamassuṃ kappetvā mañjiṭṭhavaṇṇāni dussāni nivāsetvā paṭaliyo upāhanā āruhitvā jātarūpamayaṃ daṇḍaṃ gahetvā sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ patthaṇḍile pāturahosi.

40168.meaning1: (comm) spread with a thick woollen cover embroidered with flowers

examples.text: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.
tatr'assa pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato lohitak'ūpadhāno

40169.meaning1: (comm) thick woollen spread embroidered with flowers

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalikā-atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno

40170.commentary: (VIN) paṭavāsinī nāma paṭaṃ datvā vāseti. (VINa) paṭena vasatī'ti paṭavāsinī. nivāsanamattam'pi pāvuraṇamattam'pi labhitvā bhariyābhāvaṃ upagacchantiyā dalidd'itthiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: dasa bhariyāyo, dhanakkītā chandavāsinī bhogavāsinī paṭavāsinī odapattakinī obhaṭacumbaṭā dāsī ca bhariyā ca kammakārī ca bhariyā ca dhaj'āhaṭā muhuttikā.
mañ'hi, bhante, aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ nāḷandaṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ, upāli amhākaṃ gahapati sāvakattaṃ upagato'ti.
nagaravīthiyo sodhāpetvā puṇṇaghaṭe ṭhapāpetvā dhajapaṭāk'ādayo ussāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ devavimānaṃ viya alaṅ'karonti.

40173.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in upholding monastic law
40173.construction:
paṭa + ācāra + ā
paṭa + ācāra + ā
40173.synonym: uppalavaṇṇā, khemā, bakulā, mahāpajāpati, mahāpajāpatigotamī, mahāpajāpatī, sigālamātar, siṅgālakamātar, siṅgālamātar
40173.commentary: (ANa) ath'assā ayaṃ paṭ'ācāraṃ paṭapariharaṇaṃ vinā caratī'ti paṭ'ācārā't'eva nāmaṃ akaṃsu. yasmā c'assā so naggabhāvena alajjīācāro pākaṭo ahosi, tasmā patito ācāro assā'ti paṭ'ācārā'tv'eva nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
40173.notes: Therīgāthā verses 112-116 (TH5.10, TH47) are attributed to her.

examples.text: tassā tā vacanaṃ sutvā, paṭācārāya sāsanaṃ, pāde pakkhālayitvāna, ekam'antaṃ upāvisuṃ, cetosamatham'anuyuttā, akaṃsu buddhasāsanaṃ.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ paṭācārā.

40175.commentary: (VINa) paṭāṇi dinnā hotī'ti mañcapīṭhānaṃ pādasikhāsu āṇī dinnā hoti, yattha nisīdante'pi na nippatanti

examples.text: anāpatti, avehāsakuṭiyā sīsaghaṭṭāya heṭṭhā aparibhogaṃ hoti, padarasañcitaṃ hoti, paṭāṇi dinnā hoti, tasmiṃ ṭhito gaṇhati vā laggeti vā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

40178.meaning1: unknown design used in interior decoration

examples.text: ālokasandhiparikammāyā'ti vātapānaparikammāya setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ.
so bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
n'ābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ, n'ābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ, kālañ'ca paṭikaṅkhāmi, nibbisaṃ bhatako yathā.
tassa mayhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ añña'd'atthu bhayapaṭikaṅkhī viharāmi?

40183.grammar: ind, adv, ger of paṭikaroti, trans (+acc)

examples.text: etañ'ca sallaṃ paṭikacca disvā, ajjhositā yattha pajā visattā. jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, ajjhositaṃ n'atthi tathāgatānan'ti.
alaṃ, ānanda, mā soci mā paridevi nanu etaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭikacc'eva akkhātaṃ sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo

40184.grammar: ind, adv, ger of paṭikaroti, trans (+acc)
40184.commentary: (SNa) diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādhetī'ti arahattaṃ ārādhento imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve ārādheti, tañ'ca kho paṭikacca, asampatte'y'eva maraṇakāle'ti attho.

examples.text: katame satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā? diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti. no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti, atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti.

40185.grammar: ind, adv, ger of paṭikaroti, trans (+acc)

examples.text: paṭikacc'eva taṃ kayirā, yaṃ jaññā hitam'attano, na sākaṭikacintāya, mantā dhīro parakkame.

kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati. kammaṃ kho mayā karontena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. hand'āhaṃ paṭikacc'eva vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti.

kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati. kammaṃ kho mayā karontena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. hand'āhaṃ paṭikacc'eva vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti.
paṭikacc'eva taṃ kayirā, yaṃ jaññā hitam'attano, na sākaṭikacintāya, mantā dhīro parakkame.
nanu etaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā paṭikacc'eva akkhātaṃ, sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo. taṃ kut'ettha, āvuso, labbhā.

40190.meaning1: paid back; recompensated; returned in kind

examples.text: yo ca kho mātāpitaro duppaññe paññāsampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti… ettāvatā kho mātāpitūnaṃ katañ'ca hoti paṭikatañ'ca

40191.meaning1: (comm) spread with a white woollen cloth
40191.commentary: (ANa) paṭik'atthato'ti uṇṇāmayena set'attharaṇena atthato. (SNa) paṭakatthatānī'ti ubhatolomena uṇṇāmayena setakambalena atthatāni.

examples.text: tatr'assa pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato lohitak'ūpadhāno

tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītipallaṅkasahassāni ahesuṃ dantamayāni sāramayāni sovaṇṇamayāni goṇak'atthatāni paṭik'atthatāni paṭalik'atthatāni kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇāni sauttaracchadāni ubhatolohitak'ūpadhānāni.

40192.meaning2: stepping backwards, going back or aside

40195.commentary: (ANa) ovādapaṭikarāyā'ti idaṃ vo kattabba, idaṃ na kattabban'ti dinnaovādakarāya.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ! abbhutaṃ, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ! satthu ca nāma sāsanakarā bhavissanti ovādappaṭikarā, catunnañ'ca parisānaṃ piyā bhavissanti manāpā garubhāvanīyā ca!

40199.meaning2: having made amends; having fixed; having repaired
